## Où j'en suis
Staging analytics RDS is on PostgreSQL 17.2 since Nov 17, 14:20 UTC (blue/green switchover, 41 s of refused writes): pg_partman upgraded 4.7.4 → 5.1.0 with maintenance clean on events_raw and events_daily, dbt run passed (14 models, +3% runtime vs 16.4). Runbook updated with the rds.logical_replication + reboot prerequisite for prod. PR #57 is open (draft) with commits 7e3c9d4, b0f18a2. Production cutover is not scheduled: Maya will sign off after a full week of staging on 17, then the window is picked. (source: ses-pg-3, s3-06, s3-08, s3-10, src-pr57)

- [en-cours] Soak week on staging 17.2 before prod sign-off; earliest sign-off Nov 24 (source: s3-10, src-linear-kes298)
- [prochaine-étape] Pick the production window with Maya after sign-off, avoiding the 01:00–03:30 UTC dbt lock on events_daily (source: s3-09, src-linear-kes298)
- [prochaine-étapse] Prod step 0: set rds.logical_replication = 1 and reboot (~2–3 min downtime) in its own window, before the blue/green deployment (source: s3-10)
- [essai-raté] terraform init -upgrade pulled AWS provider v6: 37 unrelated plan changes (S3 ACLs, aws_eip.vpc removal); provider pinned ~> 5.82 (source: s1-01, s1-02)
- [essai-raté] First staging apply failed: blue/green requires rds.logical_replication = 1 in the source parameter group plus a reboot; fixed and reapplied (source: s3-04, s3-06)
- [question] Exact production date and window still open (source: s3-09, src-linear-kes298)
- [décision] No production date until Maya signs off; apply_immediately stays false (source: s1-04)
- [décision] AWS provider pinned to 5.82, no v6 in this PR (source: s1-02)
